apps.localizedDescription:
CrisperWeaver:

On-device speech recognition + text-to-speech. No cloud required. 40+ model families, one app.

What you can do:

• Transcribe any audio file — WAV / MP3 / FLAC decoded on-device, no ffmpeg required.
• Batch-process multiple files — drop many onto the window or onto the Batch Queue card, "Transcribe all" drains serially; each run lands in History.
• Record from the mic and transcribe live.

• Drag and drop files onto the transcription screen (desktop) or directly on the batch queue.
• Receive shared audio from the OS share sheet (Android / iOS / macOS).

privacy.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: This app needs access to documents to save and load audio files and transcriptions.
privacy.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: This app needs access to downloads to import audio files for transcription.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: CrisperWeaver needs this only if you turn on its built-in transcription server, so other apps can send it audio. The server is off by default and accepts connections from this device unless you change its address.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app needs access to the microphone to record audio for transcription.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This app needs access to photo library to import media files for transcription.
